spec.baseline: Zero-trade cash and equal-weight long-only buy-and-hold across BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, and SOLUSDT. TSMOM is long when the selected lookback return is positive, short when negative, and flat when zero. Start with $500. Allocate equal notional across active symbols with no volatility sizing and a 1.0x gross exposure cap.

costs.assumptions: Use Binance USD-M Futures VIP 0 taker commission of 4.5 bps per fill with no BNB discount. Apply 1.5 bps slippage per side. Round-trip trading friction is 12.0 bps. Apply the recorded funding rate and settlement mark price using the declared signed-position formula and bar-boundary rule.

evaluation.development_policy: Use only the common UTC hourly grid. Each development bar contains exactly 60 consecutive source minutes. Do not forward-fill or synthesize bars. Reset momentum warmup after any gap. The local rebuilt files have no hourly gaps in the declared development window. Keep per-symbol results visible. Do not claim cross-sectional evidence from three assets. Compute Sharpe from continuous daily portfolio-equity returns, not intraday returns with a frequency multiplier.

flow_feature.diagnostic_score: Baseline score is sign of the 72-hour close-to-close return. The fixed augmented score is that baseline score plus the signed 60-minute flow imbalance. The augmented score is diagnostic only and does not generate orders.
flow_feature.formula: For each completed hourly bar, compute (2 * taker_buy_quote_volume - quote_volume) / quote_volume from the sums of its 60 consecutive 1-minute bars. A non-positive denominator invalidates the feature observation. Keep zero-volume minutes with zero taker-buy volume; do not clip source values.
flow_feature.forward_return_definition: Let i be the completed feature bar and H be the horizon in hours. The forward return is close[i + H] / open[i + 1] - 1. Require contiguous hourly bars from i+1 through i+H. The primary horizon is 1 hour.
flow_feature.sample_policy: Compute each symbol's time-series Spearman Rank IC separately. Compare the baseline and augmented scores on the same valid timestamps. Report each symbol separately and the equal-weight mean change. Do not pool the three assets as a cross-sectional panel.

zero_denominator_observations.handling: Keep the price bar for TSMOM. Exclude this timestamp from both the baseline and augmented flow comparison. Do not impute the flow value.

funding_application.boundary_limitation: Binance states that the actual funding transaction can deviate by up to 15 seconds. Hourly bars cannot resolve intra-minute order priority. The pre-open position rule is a fixed ordering convention, not exchange-exact execution. Report it as a limitation.
funding_application.formula: For signed base quantity q, positive for long and negative for short, settlement cash flow is -q * mark_price * funding_rate. A positive rate debits longs and credits shorts. A negative rate reverses the direction. Do not add a separate funding fee.
funding_application.source: Preserve timestamp, symbol, funding_interval_hours, funding_rate, and mark_price from canonical Binance USD-M funding partitions identified by run_log/crypto_tsmom_funding_inputs_20261008_source_manifest.json.
funding_application.timing: Use the recorded event timestamp and mark price. Apply funding to the position held immediately before the corresponding UTC hourly bar open. Process that funding event before any order fill at the same bar open. Use the event timestamp; do not infer an 8-hour schedule from BTC or ETH for SOL. The source records interval changes.

evaluation.holdout_policy: Do not inspect prices, flow values, returns, or strategy results from 2026-08-01 onward until the full holdout window is complete. Source coverage metadata may identify availability only. The 2025-01 through 2026-07 window was used by prior exploratory studies and is not confirmatory.
evaluation.plan: Evaluate the registered 24-hour, 72-hour, and 168-hour TSMOM variants on development data. The 72-hour variant is primary. Run one flow diagnostic against that fixed baseline. Use the verified ML4T feature, diagnostic, and backtest APIs where they support the contract. Do not tune on the prospective holdout. The future holdout is the only confirmatory strategy evaluation.

prior_trial_history.rule: Count at least 24 legacy attempts before any selection-bias adjustment, then include all newly evaluated strategy variants. Do not present a DSR as reproducible while the legacy ledger and data identities remain unresolved.

evaluation.timing: Compute the signal after each completed 1-hour bar. Fill market orders at the next 1-hour bar open. Hold each position until its signal changes, then close or reverse at the next open. Start after the 168-hour warmup. At a signal transition, allocate equal notional across active symbols, capped at 1.0x marked equity gross exposure. Do not rebalance otherwise, except proportionate taker reductions at the next bar if marked gross exposure exceeds equity.

spec.falsifier: The TSMOM claim fails if the prospective 12-month holdout has non-positive net return, annualized Sharpe below 0.80, or maximum drawdown above 20.0%. The flow feature is supported only if the paired out-of-sample improvement in per-symbol time-series Spearman Rank IC has a 95% HAC confidence interval whose lower bound is above zero at the primary 1-hour forward-return horizon. Secondary horizons are descriptive. They cannot select or tune a feature. All data through 2026-07-31 is development or previously accessed evidence, not a clean holdout.
spec.mechanism: Information may diffuse gradually. Forced liquidations may also extend price trends. Taker-buy quote volume measures aggressive buying. The feature may confirm or contradict the 72-hour trend. It will not change orders in this study. Costs, funding, reversals, and data gaps can erase either effect.
spec.thesis: A 72-hour time-series momentum signal on BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, and SOLUSDT perpetuals has positive risk-adjusted returns after Binance VIP 0 taker fees, slippage, and signed funding settlements. Signed quote-volume imbalance from the preceding 60 complete 1-minute bars may add short-horizon predictive information beyond the fixed momentum direction.

trials.description: Primary 72-bar close-to-close return sign. Long if positive, short if negative, flat if zero. Decide after the completed hour and fill at the next hourly open.
Registered 24-bar close-to-close return sign under the same position, timing, capital, cost, and funding rules. Sensitivity only. Do not replace the primary horizon with this result.
Registered 168-bar close-to-close return sign under the same position, timing, capital, cost, and funding rules. Sensitivity only. Do not replace the primary horizon with this result.

Compare per-symbol time-series Rank IC for the fixed 72-hour baseline score and the fixed augmented score on identical flow-valid timestamps. Evaluate forward returns at 1, 4, 24, and 72 hours. The 1-hour horizon is primary. Report paired out-of-sample improvement and a 95% HAC confidence interval. Do not alter trades or select a rule from secondary horizons.
